Most importantly, the tumor is entirely non-enhancing and non-necrotic, as evidenced by zero volumes for enhancing tumor and necrosis. This lack of aggressive imaging features is highly characteristic of IDH-mutant gliomas and argues strongly against an IDH-wildtype tumor, which typically presents in older patients with enhancement and/or necrosis.
